review_type: Targeted primary-source review; not a systematic review or bibliometric ranking

sources.title: FinVerse: Toward More Realistic Evaluation for Financial Time-Series Forecasting
sources.relevance: Economic semantics and evaluation metric change financial model rankings; relevant to prediction-versus-policy comparisons.

sources.title: FinTSB: A Comprehensive and Practical Benchmark for Financial Time Series Forecasting
sources.version: arXiv v3, 2026-06-01; journal reference Frontiers of Computer Science 2026
sources.status: Journal reference provided by primary arXiv record
sources.relevance: Shared evaluation protocol, market-pattern diversity and trading constraints; general financial benchmark rather than proof of crypto predictability.

sources.title: An Open Benchmark for Evaluating Time Series Forecasting Methods across Financial Markets
sources.relevance: Canonical cleaning and fixed data across methods; univariate return forecasts remain difficult while other financial targets are more forecastable.

sources.title: Improving the robustness of binary classifiers in cryptocurrency exchange rate forecasts
sources.relevance: Very close precedent: walk-forward, coverage, rule gating and costs do not establish a general trading edge. Novelty must extend beyond reporting a weak classifier.

sources.title: Benchmarking modeling architectures for cryptocurrency price prediction using financial and social media data
sources.status: Social Network Analysis and Mining research article
sources.relevance: Hourly/daily price-level forecasting with sentiment; RMSE improvements are not directly comparable to minute direction accuracy.

sources.title: LOB-Bench: Benchmarking Generative AI for Finance — an Application to Limit Order Book Data
sources.status: ICML 2025; author project and arXiv record
sources.relevance: Evaluation of generated order-book realism, statistics and market impact. Does not itself validate cryptocurrency fills.

sources.title: Conformal Prediction for Time-series Forecasting with Change Points
sources.relevance: Uncertainty adaptation to changing regimes. Coverage of prediction sets is distinct from accuracy of a point direction call.

sources.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
sources.authors: Yijia Xiao, Edward Sun, Di Luo, Wei Wang
sources.relevance: Shows active multi-agent LLM direction in equity trading; its performance claims do not transfer directly to our crypto task.

sources.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
sources.authors: David H. Bailey, Jonathan M. Borwein, Marcos López de Prado, Qiji Jim Zhu
sources.relevance: Backtest selection and repeated trials; a local test correction does not erase historical adaptive selection.

sources.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting, and Non-Normality
sources.authors: David H. Bailey and Marcos López de Prado
sources.relevance: Selection-adjusted risk-return assessment requires credible trial accounting and assumptions; not a general certification of a trading strategy.

sources.title: Random Search for Hyper-Parameter Optimization
sources.relevance: Random search is a necessary equal-budget comparator; the paper is not itself a comparison of our genetic trading algorithms.

sources.title: Leakage and the Reproducibility Crisis in ML-based Science
sources.version: Author project with evidence table updated May 2024
sources.relevance: Provenance, legitimate features and evaluation population must match scientific claims.
